description: Optional account-anchored invalidation fired for every newly committed reporting revision or post-official adjustment, whether or not health changes. Valid in every reporting tier. Receivers repair from their own durable changes_after checkpoint through get_reporting_status; this event is never the source of truth.

ext.description: Extension object for platform-specific, vendor-namespaced parameters. Extensions are always optional and must be namespaced under a vendor/platform key (e.g., ext.gam, ext.roku). Used for custom capabilities, partner-specific configuration, and features being proposed for standardization.
ext.title: Extension Object

finality.description: Finality of a reporting revision. Snapshot revisions are provisional and may be superseded. An official revision is the immutable, invoice-addressable close for its reporting slice and MUST NOT be superseded; later source corrections are explicit reporting adjustments rather than silent replacement revisions.

enumDescriptions.official: Immutable seller-authoritative close for the represented period. Buyers may key invoices and settlement records to its reporting_revision_id. Later corrections are explicit adjustments, never superseding revisions.
enumDescriptions.snapshot: Provisional seller/source reporting evidence; not sufficient by itself for billing.

finality.title: Reporting Finality

idempotency_key.description: Random per distinct fire and stable across transport retries, scoped to the authenticated sender.

notification_id.description: Stable per committed ledger record; re-emissions reuse it.

title: Reporting Ledger Changed Webhook

x-adcp-validation.logical_record: One destination-independent revision or adjustment produces one logical account event even when it fans out through multiple obligations or delivery configurations. Receivers use changes_after to resolve the affected obligations and deduplicate by the immutable record identity.
